description: This PHP file defines the Reward controller class for the OpenCart admin extension, handling the 'Reward' total in the system. It includes methods to display the Reward configuration page and save its settings.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class for the Reward total functionality in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the Reward configuration page in the admin panel.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the Reward total configuration settings via AJAX.
